scripts.build:packages: tsc -p packages/types/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/logging/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/config/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/ui/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/storage/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/auth/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/db/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/billing/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/jobs/tsconfig.json
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:api && npm run build:api:bundle && vite build
scripts.build:all: npm run build:packages && npm run build:api && npm run build:worker && npm run build:api:bundle && vite build
scripts.build:apk: cd mobile && eas build --platform android --profile preview --non-interactive
scripts.build:apk:prod: cd mobile && eas build --platform android --profile production-apk --non-interactive
scripts.build:aab:prod: cd mobile && eas build --platform android --profile production-aab --non-interactive
scripts.build:apk:wait: cd mobile && eas build --platform android --profile preview --wait
